athlete_of_the_week.why: Chambliss went 33/48 for 363 pass yds and 2 pass TD against 1 INT to power a 32-24 win over No. 10 LSU (AP). The Sr. Ole Miss QB claims his second board of the season after winning Week 1 honors with 336 yds, 3 pass TD, and a rushing TD in a 41-38 win over No. 24 Louisville.

runners_up.why: Raphael racked up 24 CAR for 197 RUSH YDS and 3 TD, but SMU fell 41-31 at Louisville, keeping the Sr. back behind the winner under the team-success criterion.
Toney posted 12 REC for 114 YDS and 1 TD in Miami's 33-20 win over Wake Forest, a strong outing that lacked the winner's opponent pedigree.
James Jr. logged 26 CAR for 121 YDS and 1 TD as Notre Dame won 27-10 over Michigan State, a workhorse day that fell short of the top statistical bar.
Completed 30 of 34 for 220 yards and three scores in the 33-20 win over Wake Forest.

criteria_note: Board applies: (1) statistical dominance versus a legitimate opponent, (2) a performance that decided a consequential game, (3) team success that week. Chambliss led all three tests — the biggest line, against No. 10 LSU (AP), in a win — while Raphael's 197 RUSH YDS came in a loss, dropping him under criterion (3).
